analysis.name: AlgorithmSpeedAnalysis / SlowExecution
analysis.issue: The algorithm is running below 40k data points per second.
analysis.sample: The algorithm executed at only 37k data points per second over the whole 16s run.
solutions: Review the algorithm code for inefficiencies.

To see where the execution time is spent, set the `performance_sample_period` setting, like `self.settings.performance_sample_period = timedelta(days=1)`, and rerun to get a "Performance" time-breakdown chart.
If there is a universe, reduce its size.
If the algorithm is training a model, reduce the amount of training data or reduce the number of epochs in the training process.

analysis.name: BrokerageModelRefusedToSubmitOrderOrderResponseErrorAnalysis / UnsupportedOrderTypeAnalysis
analysis.issue: The algorithm tried to submit or update an order type that is not supported by the brokerage model.
analysis.sample: BrokerageModel declared unable to submit order: [85] Warning - Code: NotSupported - The OandaBrokerageModel does not support MarketOnOpen order type. Only supports [Limit,Market,StopMarket,StopLimit]
solutions: Only submit or update order types that the brokerage model supports.
Change the brokerage model to one that supports the types of orders you're placing.

analysis.name: PortfolioMarginUsageAnalysis
analysis.issue: The algorithm sometimes only utilizes a small proportion of the margin available.
analysis.sample: Number of days when the 3-day SMA of the margin usage drops below 50%: 497
solutions: Adjust the strategy logic or position sizing to utilize more margin.
If the algorithm logic leads to periods of time when the portfolio sits in cash, consider holding a "risk-free" asset during these periods.

analysis.name: StatisticalSignificanceOfDailyReturnsAnalysis
analysis.issue: The distribution of the strategy's daily returns in excess of the benchmark's daily returns has a p-value above 0.05. Therefore, we fail to reject the null hypothesis that the mean of this distribution is above zero.
solutions: Try adjusting the trading rules and/or the universe to get a strategy that outperforms the benchmark.
